title: Remote viewing the inside of the Rendlesham triangular craft
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Remote viewing the inside of the Rendlesham triangular craft, about 1980 (target event); session in the 1980s at Rendlesham Forest / RAF Woodbridge, England, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and I was the one that drew the u that went inside that triangular craft and actually drew the floor plans and the insides and all that.
